'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC female Gladiator who participated in the hunt, found praying at [[Vale of Glory]] during the day with a male Gladiator named [[Guntherus]].
__NOTOC__
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
:;'''Liselotta''' If only I fought harder. I will inherit your final wishes.
:;'''Guntherus''' We will protect this city you loved so dearly.

:'''Liselotta:''' Are you here to pay respects?
:'''Liselotta:''' This is where the heroes of Septimont lie at rest. Their souls will cross the Styx Lake, forever protecting Septimont.
:'''Liselotta:''' My squadmate is among them.
:'''Liselotta:''' But, if only he weren't... If only I fought harder... I'm such a...
:'''Gunther:''' Liselotta...
----
:'''Gunther:''' I still remember our hunts. You always went for a giant's cut of steak.
:'''Gunther:''' These days, no one can finish one on their own.
:'''Gunther:''' Don't worry, we're all doing well. Liselotta even qualified for the Great Agon.
:'''Gunther:''' And... the city you loved so fiercely is in safe hands.
:'''Gunther:''' Rest easy.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
* Styx Lake refers to the Greek Mythology, where souls of the deceased are ferried into the afterlife.
